meta.name: dnanexus-integration
meta.description: Build and operate reproducible genomics workloads on DNAnexus with the dx CLI, dxpy, apps/applets, native workflows, dxCompiler, and Nextflow. Use for DNAnexus data transfers, dxapp.json development, execution monitoring, workflow import, and project automation.

copy.tagline: 让基因组分析在云端标准化自动运行
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常批量跑测序分析,希望过程可复现且云端自动调度
copy.tagline_en: Automate reproducible genomics analyses in the cloud.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage many genomics analyses and need automated reproducible runs.

howto.what: Claude 会用 dx CLI 和 dxpy 在 DNAnexus 上开发和运行基因组分析:构建部署 app/applet、上传下载与检索数据、启动并监控任务和 workflow,并编写 dxapp.json 配置。使用前需要 DNAnexus 账号并先 dx login。
howto.when: 当你要求创建或修改 DNAnexus app/applet、上传下载或检索数据、运行并监控分析与 workflow 时触发。需要 DNAnexus 账号,并先完成 dx login。

say.text: 帮我写一个 dxapp.json,输入是 BAM,输出是 VCF
say.note: Claude 生成这份 dxapp.json 规格

say.text: 搜索 project-xxxx 里所有 *.bam 文件并下载下来
say.note: Claude 检索匹配文件并逐个下载

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude builds and runs genomics workloads on DNAnexus: creating and deploying apps/applets, uploading, downloading and searching data, launching and monitoring jobs and workflows, and writing dxapp.json configs via the dx CLI and dxpy. Needs a DNAnexus account and dx login.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to build or modify DNAnexus apps/applets, move or search data, or run and monitor analyses and workflows. Requires a DNAnexus account and an active dx login.

say_en.text: Upload sample.fastq to project-xxxx, then run my alignment applet
say_en.note: Claude uploads the file and starts the applet

say_en.text: Write a dxapp.json that takes a BAM input and outputs a VCF
Find and download every *.bam file in project-xxxx
say_en.note: Claude searches and downloads matching files
